description:
Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel!

Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done.
EXPECTATIONS:
 

 Performs quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision.

 Interacts professionally with employees, customers, and business partners.

 Works effectively as a team contributor while taking ownership of individual responsibilities.

 Communicates progress, challenges, and priorities with their supervisor and other team members.

 Looks for opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data reliability, and expand technical knowledge.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
 

 Develops and maintains scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to collect, transform, and deliver data from structured and unstructured sources.

 Connects data across manufacturing and business systems, including manufacturing execution systems (MES), supervisory control and data acquisition systems (SCADA), enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), and customer relationship management systems (CRM).

 Collaborates with data architects to understand database models and improve data storage in SQL databases and cloud data warehouses.

 Builds and maintains data quality checks to identify errors and ensure data is accurate, complete, and reliable.

 Monitors and troubleshoots data pipelines, resolving issues and improving performance and cost efficiency.

 Works with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data that supports reporting and analytical solutions.

 Maintains documentation, naming conventions, version control practices, and change management processes for data pipelines and infrastructure.




ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
 

 Helps develop and implement data governance standards, including data quality, metadata, master data, privacy, and access controls.

 Works with department leaders to define data ownership, common business definitions, and how data moves between systems.

 Coordinates with Crest Corporate on shared data governance needs and standards.

 Supports the selection and adoption of data catalog, metadata management, and governance tools.

 Monitors adherence to data policies and works with business and technical teams to resolve issues.

 Facilitates collaboration among business and technical leaders through a data governance council or steering committee.

 Creates documentation and training to help employees understand data practices and responsibilities.

 Partners with legal, security, and compliance teams to align data practices with applicable requirements.

 Performs other duties as assigned.




REQUIREMENTS:
 

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Library and Information Science, Computer Science, Business Administration with a Data/IT focus, or a related field.

 Five or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, data management, data quality, data governance, or a similar role.

 Demonstrated experience building data products, using business data to solve problems, or implementing data governance frameworks.

 Familiarity with SQL, cloud data warehouses, and enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, or CRM.

 Familiarity with data integration and transformation tools such as dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, Apache NiFi, or custom-built solutions.

 Understanding of manufacturing processes, data compliance, and risk management practices.

 Strong troubleshooting, organization, and communication skills.

 Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and work with both technical and business teams.

 Experience implementing data governance practices is a plus.




WORKING CONDITIONS:
 

 Works indoors in an office and manufacturing environment.

 Regularly sits, walks, and uses a computer, including repetitive hand and wrist movements.

 May stand or walk on concrete floors.

 Works independently and with others.

 No travel is required.




As strategists, operational experts, customer advocates and team players, we all believe in the power of our people. Explore how you can become a part of our team of strength and commitment that's built to last!

DIS-TRAN Steel is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

DIS-TRAN Steel is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request information regarding reasonable accommodation, contact your Human Resource Business Partner.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c).
